releases.notes:
Version 1.1 brings lyrics in the world, lyrics marks in the track lists, more reliable playback when the Spotify app has just started, and plain error messages. One jar for every Minecraft version from 1.21 to 1.21.11.

## Which file

| File | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `SpotifyControl_1.1_1.21.x_BETA.jar` | The mod. Connects to your own Spotify account. |
| `SpotifyControl_1.1_1.21.x_DEMO.jar` | Screenshots only. Shows an invented library and never connects to Spotify. |

Install one of them, not both: they carry the same mod id, and Fabric will refuse to load two copies.

## Install

1. Fabric Loader 0.16 or higher, and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for your Minecraft version.
2. Drop `SpotifyControl_1.1_1.21.x_BETA.jar` into `mods/`.
3. In game press Ctrl + M, open Settings and paste the client ID of a Spotify app you created at [developer.spotify.com/dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard), with `http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback` as the redirect URI.

For listening parties the same jar has to be installed on the client and on the server. Broadcast mode also needs Simple Voice Chat 2.5 or higher on both sides.

## What it does

- Full overlay in the Spotify colour theme: library, search, playlist detail views and a player bar
- OAuth 2.0 login with PKCE, no client secret, tokens stored locally and refreshed automatically
- Playback control, queue, device transfer, and playlist management including reordering
- Album art and icons rasterized at screen resolution, so nothing is blocky at any GUI scale
- Six accent palettes, applied across the whole interface including the logo
- Now playing HUD, seven languages, Mod Menu integration
- Lyrics in the world: the synced lyrics of the playing song appear word by word as 3D text in front of you and fade out when their line ends. Size, distance, tilt and fade-out are adjustable, and a lyrics button next to the queue button switches them on and off
- A lyrics mark in every track list shows which songs have synced lyrics
- Listening parties in two modes: SYNC keeps every member's own Spotify player on the same track and position, BROADCAST streams the host's desktop audio through Simple Voice Chat
- On Windows, broadcast captures the speakers directly over WASAPI loopback. No Stereo Mix, no virtual cable and no microphone involved

The lyrics come from [LRCLIB](https://lrclib.net), because the Spotify Web API offers none. Only the track title and the first artist are sent there, and nothing once Lyrics in the world is switched off.

Playback control needs Spotify Premium. With a free account the overlay still browses the library, searches and shows what is playing, but the Spotify API rejects play, pause, seek and volume with HTTP 403.

Documentation is in the [wiki](https://github.com/EmilDeuOfficial/SpotifyControl/wiki). If voices or game sound end up in a broadcast, read [Streaming only Spotify](https://github.com/EmilDeuOfficial/SpotifyControl/wiki/Streaming-Only-Spotify).
